name: IINA
description: Playback control, media inspection, and playlist management for IINA.

capabilities.name: Now Playing
capabilities.intent: Show what is currently playing in IINA with time position.
capabilities.script: Query IINA for the currently playing media file, position, and duration.

capabilities.name: Media Info
capabilities.intent: Inspect codec, resolution, bitrate, and audio tracks of the current file.
capabilities.script: Read the media metadata (codec, resolution, bitrate, duration, audio tracks) of the file open in IINA.

capabilities.name: Next in Playlist
capabilities.intent: Skip to the next item in the IINA playlist.

capabilities.name: Screenshot Current Frame
capabilities.intent: Capture a screenshot of the current video frame.

cli_tools.name: iina
cli_tools.description: Open files in IINA from the command line.
